Docs preview @ https://clima.github.io/CubedSphere.jl/previews/PR30/
title: Update Documenter + use DocumenterCitations

body: This simply makes the W and Z mapping functions optional arguments to the mapping code. This is useful for testing e.g. the original Rancic vs MITgcm mapping coefficients without having to duplicate the other code.
title: Add ability to pass custom conformal maps in place of Rancic maps
